name: Petäjävesi Old Church
description: Beside a quiet lake in Petäjävesi, central Finland, stands a Lutheran country church built entirely of logs between 1763 and 1765. Its cross-shaped plan, shaped by Renaissance ideas and older Gothic vaulting, makes it a rare surviving piece of eastern Scandinavian craft. The bell tower was added in 1821, and the church still hosts summer weddings and regular Sunday services.
